name: eGov PH Post-Event Report

initialMessage.content: Hello! I'll help you create your eGov **Post-Event Report**. Let's start — what is the **name of the event**?

fields.label: Date and time of the event
Venue / location of the event
fields.example: "Paranaque Sports and Social Hall, Paranaque City"

fields.label: eGov team representatives who attended
fields.collectNote: Ask how many representatives attended first, then collect each name.

fields.label: Time of arrival at the venue
Were video and photo documentations submitted?
What happened at the event?
fields.styleNote: Write a brief description of the event including its purpose, key highlights, and how the eGov team was formally invited to participate and support the activity. Include the number of new eGovPH app downloads if mentioned. Formal, professional government report style (2-3 paragraphs).

fields.label: Issues encountered and recommendations
fields.collectNote: For each issue/concern/problem encountered, also ask what recommendation would improve future events. Collect at least one pair.

fields.label: eGovPH material condition
legend: Good Condition - Materials are usable, complete, and fully functional
Fair Condition - Materials are usable but with minor issues
Poor Condition - Materials are barely usable

fields.label: Name and position of the person who prepared the report
Name and position of the person who reviewed the report
Name and position of the person who approved the report

promptNotes: This is a POST-EVENT REPORT for the eGov PH program (eGovPH app promotion).
For the challenges list, always collect the issue AND its proposed recommendation together.
